Capabilities

Full-Cycle
Architecture

BIM & Design

Expert-level Revit BIM coordination. Full parametric modelling, family creation, multidisciplinary coordination with MEP and structural teams, BIM Execution Plans.

Site Supervision

Active quality control of finishing works — masonry, waterproofing, marble, wood/MDF, landscape. RFI and submittal review. On-site conflict resolution.

Municipality & Permits

Kuwait Municipality regulation drawings, building permit submissions, fire & safety compliance (KFF), statutory coordination from concept to approval.

Project Management

MBA-backed project scheduling, resource allocation, risk mitigation, contractor evaluation, contract negotiation, budget control, and client relationship management.

Delivering premium residential architecture is not just about beautiful drawings — it is about managing people, risk, and time with the same precision as design.
